name: office-desks
description: Pixel-art office over Orca: see your coding agents as characters, read their chats and send instructions from the browser

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bridge,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w bridge" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w bridge
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w bridge
scripts.tui: npm run build -w web && npm run tui -w bridge
scripts.test: npm test -w bridge && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w bridge && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo -w bridge
